sql: WITH t AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) AS series, upper(market_ticker) AS mkt, upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',2)) AS ev, pnl::numeric/quantity*100 AS c, CASE WHEN coalesce(side,'no')='no' THEN 100-assumed_price ELSE assumed_price END::numeric AS entry FROM paper_trades WHERE status IN ('settled','closed_sl') AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity>0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins) ), k AS ( SELECT series, mkt, ev, c, entry, CASE WHEN ev='' THEN mkt ELSE series||':'||ev END AS g FROM t ), w AS ( SELECT series, g, count(DISTINCT mkt) AS m, sum(c) AS s FROM k WHERE series IN ('KXWNBAGAME','KXMLSTOTAL','KXMLBGAME','KXCLUBFGAME','KXMLBTB','KXCS2GAME','KXLEAGUESCUPTOTAL','KXMLBTOTAL','KXATPEXACTMATCH','KXLEAGUESCUPSPREAD') GROUP BY 1,2 ), wa AS ( SELECT series, count(*) AS cnts, max(m) AS mx, round(avg(m),2) AS av, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE m>1)/count(*),0) AS pmulti, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s<0) AS lcnts, round(coalesce(sum(s) FILTER (WHERE m>1 AND s<0),0)/100,2) AS lmulti, round(coalesce(sum(s) FILTER (WHERE m=1 AND s<0),0)/100,2) AS lsingle FROM w GROUP BY 1 ), tr AS ( SELECT series, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT mkt) AS mkts, round(avg(entry),1) AS entry, round(avg(c),2) AS mean, round(sum(c)/100,2) AS tot, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE c<0)/count(*),2) AS lr, round(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c>0),3) AS aw, round(abs(avg(c) FILTER (WHERE c<0)),3) AS al FROM k WHERE series IN ('KXWNBAGAME','KXMLSTOTAL','KXMLBGAME','KXCLUBFGAME','KXMLBTB','KXCS2GAME','KXLEAGUESCUPTOTAL','KXMLBTOTAL','KXATPEXACTMATCH','KXLEAGUESCUPSPREAD') GROUP BY 1 ), xs AS ( SELECT a.series, a.ev, count(DISTINCT b.series) AS ns FROM (SELECT DISTINCT series, ev FROM k WHERE series IN ('KXWNBAGAME','KXMLSTOTAL','KXMLBGAME','KXCLUBFGAME','KXMLBTB','KXCS2GAME','KXLEAGUESCUPTOTAL','KXMLBTOTAL','KXATPEXACTMATCH','KXLEAGUESCUPSPREAD') AND ev<>'') a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT series, ev FROM k WHERE ev<>'') b ON b.ev=a.ev GROUP BY 1,2 ), xa AS (SELECT series, round(avg(ns),2) AS asp, max(ns) AS msp FROM xs GROUP BY 1) SELECT tr.series||'|'||tr.n||'|'||tr.mkts||'|'||tr.entry||'|'||tr.mean||'|'||tr.tot||'|'||tr.lr ||'|'||coalesce(tr.aw::text,'0')||'|'||coalesce(tr.al::text,'0') ||'|'||wa.cnts||'|'||wa.lcnts||'|'||wa.mx||'|'||wa.av||'|'||wa.pmulti ||'|'||wa.lmulti||'|'||wa.lsingle||'|'||coalesce(xa.asp::text,'1')||'|'||coalesce(xa.msp::text,'1') AS row FROM tr JOIN wa ON wa.series=tr.series LEFT JOIN xa ON xa.series=tr.series ORDER BY tr.series
